sourceText:
French Toast Bites
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 4, 2009 - 12:46am

Ingredients




2 slc whole-wheat or cracked wheat bread
1/4 cup liquid egg substitute
3 tablespoons low-fat (1%%) milk
1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract
1 pch cinnamon or nutmeg
1 pch salt (optional)

Preparation

1 Cut each bread slice into 4 squares or triangles. In a medium shallow bowl or flat casserole, stir together the egg substitute, milk, vanilla, cinnamon, and salt (if desired). 2 Add the bread. With a large flat spoon or narrow blade spatula, gently move the squares around slightly to help them absorb the liquid. When about half the liquid has been absorbed, turn them and repeat the process until most of the egg mixture is used up. 3 Transfer the squares to a large nonstick spray-coated nonstick skillet preheated over medium heat. Brown each slice for 3 to 4 minutes, turning each over once with a narrow blade spatula during cooking. Serve plain or with a desired topping. 4 This recipe yields 2 servings. 5 Serving size: 1 piece. 6 Comments: Top with mashed banana, crushed pineapple, some low-fat vanilla yogurt, or some sugar-free pancake syrup.
